entry.title: Issue 1: LLM judges that flip their own verdicts, OpenCode 2.1 and Salesforce's $5.7 billion Braze deal lead the day, while Euclid finds a comet, Hormuz tensions climb, and Diwali weekend events open in the South Bay.
entry.summary: LLM judges flip verdicts on reruns and answer-order swaps; one fully repeatable judge was right only 51% of the time; OpenCode 2.1.0 changes SDK, event and plugin contracts and adds Windows persistent terminals; Salesforce to acquire Braze for about $5.66 billion; Euclid discovers its first new comet, C/2026 S1; US and Iran both claim control of the Strait of Hormuz as ship attacks climb
